text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was when we were stretching
before training—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer.
Could you give me just a little more time?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
My calves and hamstrings
still feel pretty stiff... I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Before, I was fine even with less...
'I' shouldn't be that fragile of a material—or so I thought.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems fatigue has accumulated from running
in back-to-back races. It might be wise to reconsider
her upcoming race plan.
